description: Election Commission - Elected K. L. R. Karadana as the member of the Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government authority (Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls under electoral processes and related matters for local government bodies.
